beats.gap: P1-FL04.2 (R138): the arcade controller is forgiving on landing, so landing tipped the other way (over) no longer costs speed (well 5.43 s, plain 5.46 s, over 5.38 s to the gate). R129's landing tiers (bad landing loses speed or spins) are P1-FL07 (br-bbki.7), which closes this gap.
